author_note: This file is written BEFORE the H52 holdout is executed. It fixes the instrument, the comparison, the promotion rule and the failure conditions so that no result can be re-interpreted after the fact. Times are UTC; the exact execution receipt is evidence/h52_holdout_<utc>.json written by scripts/run_h52_holdout.py.
question: Does a strike-aligned line emission (SALE) of the repository's best belief field, confined to a broad Stage-1 strain-budget approved domain, beat the incumbent point-emission geometry at identical emitted mass, without the Stage-1 mask dominating the placement?

instrument.design: six contiguous 3x3 spatial blocks of the visible USGS+INGENIOUS catalogue, 12 px (1.2 km) training buffer, 250,000 background negatives per fold, fixed seeds
instrument.truth: visible catalogue inside the held-out block (proxy for hidden new faults)
instrument.known: visible catalogue outside the block (the scorer's masked domain)
instrument.budget: emitted dots = 3.47 x n_truth of the fold (matched mass across all variants)
instrument.readings: both scoring conventions of gems51.live_metric are reported (A: on-catalogue mass deleted; B: counted as FP)
instrument.known_bias: the block boundary is unmasked, so the local instrument cannot measure the value of the catalogue-flank rule; that parameter is set from the live-anchored sibling evidence recorded in gems51.live_metric and only checked here
instrument.not_a_score: the proxy truth is the visible catalogue. A pass licenses packaging, never a leaderboard claim.

field.arm_HH: base 58-feature stack + extras matching 'facecoh' and 'hh_' (H-H edge-termination / conductive-relay)
field.arm_HD: base 58-feature stack + extras matching 'facecoh' (H-D scarp-facing coherence)
field.blend: arithmetic mean of the two arms' folded predicted probabilities (fixed 50/50, the repository's historical local benchmark recipe)
field.leakage_control: d_cat / cat_dens columns are excluded from the model by gems51.detector.Stack; catalogue-dependent features are never passed

stage1.definition: quantile-10 broad approved domain of the fold-specific strain-budget deficit (observed geodetic 2nd-invariant tile rank minus mapped-trace Kostrov tile rank), recomputed per fold with the held-out trace rows removed
stage1.confinement: every Stage-2 dot must lie inside the approved domain (hard mask, enforced in emission)
stage1.cost_limit: the confined variant may lose at most 0.0050 proxy DTI versus the same variant unconfined

variants.V0: incumbent: NMS r=2.4, catalogue flank 2 px, block-confined
variants.V1: NMS r=2.8, catalogue flank 2 px, block-confined
variants.V2: NMS r=2.8, catalogue flank 3 px, block-confined
variants.V3: SALE lines (half-length 5 px, spacing 2.4 px, seed separation 6 px) with catalogue flank 3 px, block-confined
variants.V4: V2 inside the Stage-1 approved domain
variants.V5: V3 inside the Stage-1 approved domain

promotion_rule.primary: the confined candidate (V4 or V5, whichever has the higher six-fold mean DTI under reading B) must beat V0 on the six-fold mean by >= +0.0020 and be positive in >= 4 of 6 folds
promotion_rule.secondary: its Stage-1 lift (emitted share inside approved tiles / approved area share) must be <= 1.5
promotion_rule.tertiary: its Stage-1 confinement cost versus the identical unconfined variant must be <= 0.0050 mean DTI
promotion_rule.format: all cells finite in [0,1], single-band float32, EPSG:32611, exact template transform, no NaN, no out-of-range cell
promotion_rule.uniqueness: no byte identity, support Jaccard <= 0.50 and containment <= 0.60 against (a) every prior artifact in data/prior and data/refs, (b) the fetched top sibling submissions listed in registry/sibling_tiff_inventory.json
promotion_rule.failure: if no confined variant passes, no TIFF is written and the negative result is published on the site

external_evidence_used_for_parameters_no.claim: on-published-catalogue mass is penalised (scoring reading B)
external_evidence_used_for_parameters_no.source: https://github.com/buffedlizard55-lab/GEMSDOE32 README, Round 4: 40,199-dot file owner-reported live 0.2708 vs its 44,090-dot superset owner-reported live 0.2600; the only difference is 3,891 dots inside 100 m of the published catalogue
external_evidence_used_for_parameters_no.class: OWNER-REPORT about a live score (not organizer-published)

external_evidence_used_for_parameters_no.claim: widening the catalogue flank from 100 m to 200 m improved the calibrated proxy
